scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @memebot/server" "npm run dev:worker -w @memebot/server" "npm run dev -w @memebot/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @memebot/shared && npm run build -w @memebot/server && npm run build -w @memebot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @memebot/shared && npm run typecheck -w @memebot/server && npm run typecheck -w @memebot/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @memebot/server && npm run lint -w @memebot/web
